title: Canada IRCC family sponsorship (spousal, outland) — assembly conventions

official_sources.label: IRCC: Sponsor your spouse, partner or child

heic.human_action: Export JPEG or PNG first, then image_to_pdf.

notes: This guide is assembly convention only. It does not classify documents and does not name required evidence.
It never claims a package is submission_ready or complete enough to file.
Encrypted, form, and signed PDFs are copy or rename only.
HEIC/HEIF must be exported to JPEG or PNG before image_to_pdf.
Office files convert only when the local converter is present; macros and remote links are refused.
Portal upload size is commonly 4 MiB per file (4194304 bytes). Over-budget files fail unless the plan names an explicit compress budget.
Photo sheets use a 1, 2, or 4 cell grid, fit without crop, and keep order and captions as the approved plan wrote them.
